items.title: How to Turn $250,000 Into Nearly $1,000 a Month in Passive Income
items.summary: Paychecks stop in retirement, but the bills never do. Five dividend payers spanning telecoms, tobacco, and oil can team up to cover a surprising amount of that gap every single month of the year.

items.title: State Street Consumer Staples SPDR (XLP) Sells $17.0 Million of Walmart on Nov. 2

items.title: Altria vs. Philip Morris: Higher Yield or Faster Dividend Growth for Retirees?
items.summary: Both tobacco giants beat earnings estimates, raised their dividends, and surged more than 30% this year, but they pull retirees in opposite directions when it comes to income now versus income later.

items.title: Can Altria's on! PLUS 12mg Rollout Accelerate Nicotine Pouch Growth?
items.summary: MO's nationwide on! PLUS 12mg rollout strengthens its nicotine pouch portfolio, tapping rising demand for higher strengths and expanding opportunities in oral nicotine.

items.title: 5 High-Yield Dividend Stocks That Raised Their Payouts in 2026
items.summary: Five income stocks cleared a rare filter this year: every single one raised its dividend payout, even as interest rates punished yield hunters. Find out which names backed those raises with data-center contracts, smoke-free cash flow, and free cash flow that covers the dividend twice over.

items.title: 3 mega-cap stocks to keep an eye on
items.summary: “Too big to fail” is how we would describe the megacap stocks in this article today. While they will likely stand the test of time, it’s not all sunshine and rainbows as their scale can limit their ability to find new sources of growth.
